runtime.standing_access: Migration-reviewed application grants only; no schema ownership or audit/financial-history deletion.

migration.standing_access: Schema ownership and reviewed forward migrations only; never application runtime.

backup.standing_access: Read-only database backup access; no application worker or write authority.

restore.standing_access: Connect only by default; restore elevation requires a separately authorized controlled procedure.

human_admin.standing_access: Exceptional controlled diagnostics only; no standing table mutation or financial-history edit path.

bootstrap.standing_access: Dedicated one-time initial Owner bootstrap functions only; no standing table access and mutation capability is permanently revoked at atomic closure.
